svg.text: Each published exponent needs its own height: the dial is re-set every time

two loops, 2 + ε at ε = 2: s = 1.690
every curve starts at s = 1: one loop is exact near d = 2
Left: black curve is ours (e-every-height). Each dot is the
height that turns one published exponent into θ = (d − 2) ln e_s.
Right: the height that works moves with d, so it is not a
Known: the five exponents (README). Ours: e_s and the heights.
